# Test Fixtures

Synthetic media used by the CleanShare test suite. Regenerate with:

```bash
bash scripts/make-dirty-fixtures.sh
```

## Provenance & License

All fixtures are **CC0 / public domain**. Pixels are synthesized in-house from
solid colors (via `ffmpeg`/`sips`) — there is **no source-photo provenance**, no
real EXIF, no real location, no identifiable subject. The metadata is injected
synthetically with `exiftool` purely to exercise the stripping pipeline.

## `dirty/` — metadata-laden inputs

| File | Pixels | Injected metadata (to be stripped) |
|---|---|---|
| `iphone_sample.jpg` | 200×200 JPEG | EXIF GPS lat/lon, Make=Apple, Model=iPhone 15 Pro, Apple MakerNote (CameraSerialNumber) |
| `pixel_sample.jpg` | 200×200 JPEG | EXIF Make=Google, Model=Pixel 8, XMP:Creator |
| `transparent.png` | 64×64 transparent PNG | PNG tEXt Comment |
| `animated.gif` | 2-frame GIF | XMP packet (Creator) |
| `lightroom.jpg` | 200×200 JPEG | Heavy XMP block (Creator, Subject, Description, HierarchicalSubject, Rating) |

## `cleaned/`

Output of the cleaning pipeline against the `dirty/` inputs. Generated by tests;
asserted to contain no sensitive metadata groups via `MetadataAuditor`.
